description: This Java class 'MessageDeserializer' provides static methods for deserializing 'Message' objects from JSON representations within a messaging system. It handles extracting message headers and payloads, and interprets content types to determine payload format.

classes.name: MessageDeserializer
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for deserializing Message objects from JSON representations, handling headers, payloads, and content type interpretation.

methods.name: deserializeMessageFromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a Message from its JSON representation, decoding the payload with Base64.

methods.name: deserializeMessageFromHeadersAndPayload
methods.description: Constructs a Message object from message headers and payload JSON value, considering content type.

methods.name: shouldBeInterpretedAsTextOrJson
methods.description: Determines if the message payload should be interpreted as text or JSON based on the content type.
